boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Box Office is open two hours before each show and remains open through intermission. Below are additional walk-up hours: Monday - Friday: 10:00AM - 5:00PM Saturdays: 10:00AM - 2:00PM Sundays: Summer Hours: Monday - Thursday: 10:00AM - 5:00PM Friday: 10:00AM - 2:00PM Saturdays: Closed
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Tickets can be purchased with cash, gift cards, Visa, Master Card, American Express & Discover Shea�s concession points are cashless. All concession and bar purchases can be made by credit card, debit card, gift card, or mobile wallet. Cash can be exchanged for a gift card in any amount at our Box Office and used at all concessions.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Customer can pick up tickets within the hour prior to the show in the Main Street entrance of the Theatre. Customer must present the actual credit card used to place the order and a photo ID. Customer can call (716) 847-0850 for special handling.

venues.parkingDetail: Street Parking is free in the city on weekends and after 5:00 PM on weekdays, but availability is limited. Paid Parking Lots are also available within a couple blocks of the theater. For more information, please visit our Parking page. If you are taking the NFTA-Metro train downtown, the Fountain Plaza Station is located one block south of the Shea's Performing Arts Center. If you are using a Ride-Sharing app, please use 439 Pearl Street as the address for ride-sharing services pick-up and drop-off location point at Shea's Buffalo Theatre.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: ASL-interpreted performances are available upon request. Please contact our Box Office at least one week before the show for assistance with ticketing and scheduling an interpreter. Assisted listening devices are available at the Coat Check station free of charge. Autism & Sensory Accommodations: A designated quiet room is available for patrons who may need a calm, low-stimulus space during their visit, before and during performances. Families and patrons with autism, sensory sensitivities, or other special needs are encouraged to contact the Shea's Box Office at least a week in advance. Booster Seats are available at the Coat Check station Wheelchair access is available on Shea's Buffalo Theatre's main level. As a National Historic Site, the theatre does not currently have elevators or accessible seating in the balcony. Wheelchair access is available through the entrances on Main Street. For patrons parking on Pearl Street, come through Curtain Up Alley to reach Main Street. Contact the Box Office to secure accessible seating. We are here to help support a comfortable and enjoyable theatre experience. Patrons are encouraged to reach out to the Shea's Box Office by calling 716-847-0850 or send a message to: www.sheas.org/contact.

generalInfo.generalRule: Walk-through metal detection screening is in effect. Outside food & beverage is prohibited Firearms and smoking/e-cigarettes are prohibited. Small clutch purses/bags are recommended (4.5"x6.5") and may be subject to inspection. Exceptions: medically necessary items and diaper bags.
generalInfo.childRule: All children who have reached their 1st birthday are required to have a ticket. Performances are not recommended for children under 5 years old, with the exception of family shows. Productions at Shea's are mostly enjoyed by young people ages 8+. Please refer to the performance page for suitable age guidelines for each show.

events.name: CHRIS TOMLIN, TOBYMAC, THIRD DAY
events.info: Three names. One tour. And a fall lineup that is almost too impressive to believe. When CHRIS TOMLIN, TOBYMAC, THIRD DAY tour together, it is a night big enough to make people book flights, text friends, and clear the calendar! The set list is full of endless #1 hits and award-winning music to make this an unforgettable show. Three headliners. No filler. You will pay for the seat, but you are bound to spend the night on your feet! Lineup subject to change. Discounts cannot be combined. boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: Shea's Box Office is located at 650 Main Street, Buffalo NY 14202 (next door to Shea's Buffalo Theatre). The Box Office phone number is 716- 847-0850 or email patronservices@sheas.org
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Box Office is open two hours before each show and remains open through intermission. Below are additional walk-up hours: Monday - Friday: 10:00AM - 5:00PM Saturdays: 10:00AM - 2:00PM Sundays: Summer Hours: Monday - Thursday: 10:00AM - 5:00PM Friday: 10:00AM - 2:00PM Saturdays: Closed
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Tickets can be purchased with cash, gift cards, Visa, Master Card, American Express & Discover Shea�s concession points are cashless. All concession and bar purchases can be made by credit card, debit card, gift card, or mobile wallet. Cash can be exchanged for a gift card in any amount at our Box Office and used at all concessions.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Customer can pick up tickets within the hour prior to the show in the Main Street entrance of the Theatre. Customer must present the actual credit card used to place the order and a photo ID. Customer can call (716) 847-0850 for special handling.

venues.parkingDetail: Street Parking is free in the city on weekends and after 5:00 PM on weekdays, but availability is limited. Paid Parking Lots are also available within a couple blocks of the theater. For more information, please visit our Parking page. If you are taking the NFTA-Metro train downtown, the Fountain Plaza Station is located one block south of the Shea's Performing Arts Center. If you are using a Ride-Sharing app, please use 439 Pearl Street as the address for ride-sharing services pick-up and drop-off location point at Shea's Buffalo Theatre.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: ASL-interpreted performances are available upon request. Please contact our Box Office at least one week before the show for assistance with ticketing and scheduling an interpreter. Assisted listening devices are available at the Coat Check station free of charge. Autism & Sensory Accommodations: A designated quiet room is available for patrons who may need a calm, low-stimulus space during their visit, before and during performances. Families and patrons with autism, sensory sensitivities, or other special needs are encouraged to contact the Shea's Box Office at least a week in advance. Booster Seats are available at the Coat Check station Wheelchair access is available on Shea's Buffalo Theatre's main level. As a National Historic Site, the theatre does not currently have elevators or accessible seating in the balcony. Wheelchair access is available through the entrances on Main Street. For patrons parking on Pearl Street, come through Curtain Up Alley to reach Main Street. Contact the Box Office to secure accessible seating. We are here to help support a comfortable and enjoyable theatre experience. Patrons are encouraged to reach out to the Shea's Box Office by calling 716-847-0850 or send a message to: www.sheas.org/contact.

generalInfo.generalRule: Walk-through metal detection screening is in effect. Outside food & beverage is prohibited Firearms and smoking/e-cigarettes are prohibited. Small clutch purses/bags are recommended (4.5"x6.5") and may be subject to inspection. Exceptions: medically necessary items and diaper bags.
generalInfo.childRule: All children who have reached their 1st birthday are required to have a ticket. Performances are not recommended for children under 5 years old, with the exception of family shows. Productions at Shea's are mostly enjoyed by young people ages 8+. Please refer to the performance page for suitable age guidelines for each show.
